name: com.cyclone-games.dynamic-atlas
description: Bounded runtime sprite atlas with explicit leases: packs runtime-sourced sprites onto a fixed set of uncompressed pages under page, entry, and byte ceilings, with a per-frame miss budget, GPU-first copy paths, and a documented extraction contract for build-time SpriteAtlas pages.

samples.description: Acquire, retain, and dispose sprite leases through DynamicAtlasService.
